name: Card
description: Groups related content onto one bounded surface.
propsSummary: tone: neutral|danger (default: neutral) - danger draws the edge in the danger ink
padding: none|md (default: md) - md is the compact inset (12); none + Card.Header divided + Card.Body padding = panel
selected: boolean - the selection wash and ring
as: article|div|section (default: article) - static card root element
render: ReactElement - a real link or button for an interactive card
Sub-components: Card.Header, Card.Title, Card.Description, Card.Body, Card.Footer
Card.Body padding: none|md - use for panel body spacing

tone.description:
`danger` draws the edge in the danger ink, for a card whose content is
held (a blocked merge). There is no wash; the words inside say why.

padding.description:
Inner padding: `md` is the compact surface inset (12); `none` lets a
divided header and `Card.Body` own their inset (a table sheet).

selected.description:
Marks the card as the chosen one: the selection wash, and the hairline
turns into the selection ring. Pair it with the ARIA state that fits the
element (`aria-pressed` on a button, `aria-current` on a link).

as.description: Root element tag for a static card.

render.description:
Makes the card one interactive element: pass a real link or button,
`render={<a href="/repos/web" />}` or `render={<button type="button" />}`.
It gains the hover tint, the press scale and the focus ring. A button
holds phrasing content only, so any render other than a plain `<a>`
draws every part as a `span` (Title loses its heading level). Keep other
controls out of an interactive card.

when: Grouping related content behind one boundary
Separating sections that spacing alone cannot
whenNot: Plain text that needs no grouping
guidelines: One surface: the surface plane, the hairline, the surface corner, no shadow
Cards sharing a grid row should size uniformly
tone="danger" is the only state chrome; put other state in a Badge or Alert inside
padding="none" plus Card.Header divided and Card.Body padding is the panel
A feature mosaic is Grid.Item colSpan and rowSpan around a Card
Prefer a Button or Link inside the card; when the whole card acts, pass render
accessibility: Card is a semantic container (article/div/section); render={<a href />} or render={<button />} makes it one real interactive element
A selected card pairs selected with aria-pressed on a button or aria-current on a link
Card titles should be appropriate heading levels

dont.reason: Do not use a Card as a modal surface.

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Quiet surface with a title and description.

examples.name: Content Only
examples.description: Body alone, when there is nothing to title.

examples.name: With Footer
examples.description: Footer parks the actions below the content.
examples.code:
<Card>
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Card with footer</Card.Title>
            <Card.Description>Complete card layout</Card.Description>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Body>Main content area.</Card.Body>
          <Card.Footer>Footer actions go here</Card.Footer>
        </Card>

examples.name: Metric
examples.description: A metric tile is the same surface: the figure on the display step, tabular.
examples.code:
<Card>
          <Card.Body>
            <Text as="p" type="display" tabularNums>
              94%
            </Text>
            <Text as="p" color="secondary">
              Component coverage
            </Text>
          </Card.Body>
        </Card>

examples.name: Panel
examples.description: A 40px divided head with the line below and no fill; the body owns its own spacing.

examples.name: Danger Tone
examples.description: The only state chrome: the edge in the danger ink, no wash.
examples.code:
<Card tone="danger">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Merge held</Card.Title>
            <Card.Description>Two blocking findings need a decision.</Card.Description>
          </Card.Header>
        </Card>

examples.name: Interactive
examples.description: render makes the card a real link or button: gated hover tint, press scale, focus ring. Inside a button the parts draw as spans.
examples.code:
<Card render={<a href="#details" />}>
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>Open details</Card.Title>
            <Card.Description>The whole card is one link</Card.Description>
          </Card.Header>
        </Card>

examples.name: Selected
examples.description: The chosen card: the selection wash, and the hairline turns into the ring.

examples.name: Section Root
examples.description: The as prop matches the surrounding document semantics.
examples.code:
<Card as="section" aria-labelledby="billing-card-title">
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title id="billing-card-title">Billing summary</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Body>Section semantics support the surrounding document outline.</Card.Body>
        </Card>

examples.name: Nested Heading
examples.description: Pick the heading level the page outline expects.
examples.code:
<Card padding="none">
          <Card.Header divided>
            <Card.Title as="h4">Nested panel</Card.Title>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Body padding="md">Panel content</Card.Body>
        </Card>

examples.name: Long Content
examples.description: Long titles and dense text wrap without breaking the surface.
examples.code:
<Card>
          <Card.Header>
            <Card.Title>
              A detailed localized account recovery policy for administrators across multiple
              workspaces
            </Card.Title>
            <Card.Description>
              Supporting content remains readable when translated strings take substantially more
              space than the English source.
            </Card.Description>
          </Card.Header>
          <Card.Body>
            Recovery settings apply to every affected administrator and retain an auditable history
            of the notification decision.
          </Card.Body>
        </Card>

relations.note: Use Grid + Card for responsive card layouts
Use List for linear, text-first layouts
